title: What Really Sank Red Lobster
sentence: In 2014, Golden Gate Capital bought Red Lobster from Darden for $2.1 billion, and in the same deal the real estate under about 500 restaurants was sold to American Realty Capital Properties for $1.5 billion and leased back, with rent rising 2% a year; Red Lobster's 2024 bankruptcy declaration cites about 30% fewer customers since 2019 and about $190.5 million in lease obligations in 2023.
source: Darden sells Red Lobster to Golden Gate Capital (May 16, 2014): https://investor.darden.com/news/news-details/2014/Darden-Announces-Sale-of-Red-Lobster-to-Golden-Gate-Capital-for-2.1-Billion-2014-5-16/default.aspx
